body:
Qualify Git CLI merge behavior, including the plan’s explicit-base semantics.

- [ ] Corpus: disjoint same-file hunks, same-hunk conflict, rename/edit, delete/edit, executable mode, binary and file/directory conflicts. Compare expected trees/conflicts with cherry-pick under equivalent bases.
- [ ] Prove stale and dependent submissions use the intended base after squash landing; record multiple/no merge-base policy instead of guessing.
- [ ] Measure median below 100 ms on a 100k-file repository with reproducible hardware, Git version and fixture generator. Failed criteria trigger ADR revision, not a threshold silently changed to pass.
- [ ] Qualify attributes/custom-driver behavior and trust for merge-tree; do not assume a working-tree merge driver works identically. Integration tree construction must require no checkout.
- [ ] Commit throwaway fixture script and go/no-go report under docs/spikes/.

## Objects, priority and bounded recovery

Extend fixture corpus to file/symbol/config/module units, containment, generated/ambiguous fallback and rename delete-plus-add; validate receive versus final post-regeneration manifests. Approximate extraction cannot approve semantic independence.
title: S2: Qualify tree-only Git merges against a differential corpus
